You're taller in the morning
You're taller in the morning
Between the bones
of your spine are soft
discs,
full of water.
Standing all day
squeezes water out,
and you lose
a centimetre or two.
Lying down at night,
the discs soak it back up.
Astronauts in orbit
stretch even more, up to 3 %.
Measure your height
before breakfast.
